propositions: The deployed Gerrit review bot must load and execute the review-phase-boundaries criterion end-to-end through the four-pass pipeline in a live probe, with advisory (non-blocking) results collected without disrupting contributors.
A positive-control patchset adding discovery/evidence refinement must yield zero findings for the project criterion, establishing baseline behavior when the criterion applies valid discovery logic.

A predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control corpus patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], Pass-2 validity and impact attributes, and Pass-3 decision=advisory with block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false.

A final cleaned patchset must remove negative directives, restore only valid phase-compliant instructions, and be the sole revision submitted to main, with routing remaining block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false.

Blocking promotion is deferred to a future separately-reviewed data-backed ticket; this dogfood observes criterion execution and priority distribution without changing the rubric or enabling blocking.
Any defect in the rubric or seam discovered during the probe must be captured as a separate ticket linked discovered_from and is fixed only through that separately reviewed work.
